image_description: A close-up shot of a glass sundae dish containing a complex dessert. The base appears to be chocolate cake or brownie chunks mixed with red fruit compote (likely cherry or strawberry). There are scoops of white ice cream (vanilla) topped with chocolate syrup and a dusting of cocoa powder. A single scoop of chocolate ice cream sits in the foreground. The dish is garnished with a slice of yellow fruit, possibly pineapple or mango, on top. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the glossy textures of the syrup and the glass.
